shouldFix.title: The Measured-inputs table and the remeasurement custody clause drop frozen leftover-join v4, v5, v6 and frozen corpus v3, while the draft still asserts their standing; both D-238 and D-239 pinned every frozen sibling they named
shouldFix.where: Measured inputs table (lines 51-63); remeasurement clause (lines 65-71); lines 79-81; lines 92 and 103-104; lines 107-108
shouldFix.claimUnderReview: The draft asserts, unpinned: 'Frozen v4, v5, and v6 remain historical. Do not record v4, v5, v6, or v7 as current.' (lines 80-81), 'Frozen v4, v5, v6, and v7 are not recorded as current.' (lines 103-104), and 'leftover-design of the four D-237 implementations is stale as an authoring claim.' (lines 92, 107-108). The Measured-inputs table pins only leftover-join v7, corpus v4 and occupancy v2 among the frozen siblings. The remeasurement clause protects only 'file 08, leftover-join v8, both Stage A verdicts, leftover-join v7, corpus v4, occupancy v2, and this draft'.

evidence.convention_D238_same_lineage: D-238 (coordinator-decisions.D-238.turn2.draft.md), the immediately preceding entry in this same leftover-join lineage, made the identical claim ('Do not record v4, v5, or v6 as current') and pinned all three in its Measured-inputs table -- 'Frozen v6 (split; not this subject) 5ce314b7...', 'Frozen v5 (split; not this subject) d7a8daf6...', 'Frozen v4 (historical D-198; not this subject) a542dc6b...' -- plus 'Frozen corpus v3 (D-237; not this subject) 3576e2e6...'. Its remeasurement clause named them operatively: '...both Stage A verdicts, frozen v4, frozen v5, frozen v6, corpus v3, frozen turn-1 subject, and this draft unmoved'.
evidence.convention_D239: D-239 (coordinator-decisions.D-239.draft.md) did the same for its own lineage: it pinned 'Frozen v1 04aa15a7...', 'Frozen v2 a45cb48d...', 'Frozen v3 3576e2e6...' in the table and named them in the clause: '...both Stage A verdicts, frozen v1, frozen v2, frozen v3, leftover-join v7, occupancy v2, and this draft unmoved'.
evidence.measured_absence: Measured on disk at HEAD 0c58fe1ed10d4e0c50f8d36290d7952e77bff4a4: g23-leftover-join.v4.json a542dc6b023d07cf8657c76909ded1641efd29277760308d52574fa706fad56e (0444), g23-leftover-join.v5.json d7a8daf64f8179843068f44b11c0299558ad381b33baec75eb97de9ae1247f08 (0444), g23-leftover-join.v6.json 5ce314b7bc526376b5995d492c31427be75e037302feb775650f46e519dec887 (0444), g23-fixture-corpus.v3.json 3576e2e606b3eed68feced5b83a34247263d3b563274ef3fd9054c8b2a2ba6a7 (0444). grep of the subject for each of those four digests returns 0 occurrences.
evidence.scope_is_larger_not_smaller: D-240's claim set over frozen siblings is strictly larger than D-238's -- it adds v7 to the do-not-record-as-current list and retains the D-237 staleness claim -- so the custody set should have grown, not shrunk.
evidence.transitive_pin_does_not_close_the_gap: g23-leftover-join.v8.json (pinned at 498324e5...) does cite all four digests internally (a542dc6b x1, d7a8daf6 x1, 5ce314b7 x2, 3576e2e6 x2). That preserves the digest of record but does not protect the referents: v8's bytes are unchanged if g23-leftover-join.v4.json, v5, v6 or g23-fixture-corpus.v3.json moves on disk, and the draft's remeasurement clause then requires no remasurement before adoption.

shouldFix.whyItMatters: The remeasurement clause is the operative gate that decides whether this entry may be adopted without remasurement. Four files about which the draft makes positive standing assertions sit outside that gate. The entry could be adopted while 'Frozen v4, v5, and v6 remain historical' and 'leftover-design of the four D-237 implementations is stale' were unverified against live bytes -- a condition D-238 and D-239 both explicitly foreclosed.
shouldFix.aggravatingDetail: Line 62 pins a row labelled 'Frozen corpus v4 (D-239; not this subject)'. Eighteen lines later the prose says 'Frozen v4, v5, and v6 remain historical' and 'Do not record v4, v5, v6, or v7 as current', where bare 'v4' denotes leftover-join v4, which is unpinned. An unpinned bare 'v4' sits directly beneath a pinned 'corpus v4' row in the same document.
shouldFix.suggestedRemedy: Restore the D-238/D-239 convention: add 'Frozen leftover-join.v4 (D-198; not this subject) a542dc6b...', 'Frozen leftover-join.v5 (split; not this subject) d7a8daf6...', 'Frozen leftover-join.v6 (split; not this subject) 5ce314b7...' and 'Frozen corpus v3 (D-237; not this subject) 3576e2e6...' to the Measured-inputs table, and name frozen leftover-join v4, v5, v6 and corpus v3 in the remeasurement clause's unmoved set. Labelling the leftover-join rows 'leftover-join.v4/v5/v6' also removes the bare-'v4' collision with the pinned corpus v4 row.
shouldFix.doesNotRequire: This remedy touches only the D-240 draft. It does not require editing file 08, COORD, leftover-join v8, either Stage A verdict, corpus v3, corpus v4, occupancy v2, or any frozen leftover-join.

observations.title: The draft flattens D-238's recorded distinction between frozen v4 (a historical measurement as of D-198) and frozen v5/v6 (historical dual splits), and drops the 'as of D-198' anchor for v4
observations.evidence: D-238 recorded: 'Frozen v4 remains a historical measurement as of D-198. Frozen v5 remains a historical split (Codex REJECT G23LJ-V5-M1/S1; Claude ACCEPT 0/0). Frozen v6 remains a historical split (Codex ACCEPT 0/0; Claude REJECT CLAUDE-G23LJ-V6-M1/S1).' D-240 compresses this to 'Frozen v4, v5, and v6 remain historical.' while retaining the per-version anchor for v7 ('remains a historical measurement as of D-238').
observations.whyNotScored: Every version named is in fact historical, so nothing asserted is false, and D-240's Reversibility list ('D-147, D-223, D-237, D-238, or D-239') follows D-239's own precedent of dropping D-198. This is a precision loss, not a misstatement. The CLAUDE-D240-SF1 remedy, which labels each frozen row by lineage and recording decision, would restore the anchor as a side effect. No separate change requested.

decision: OBJECT -- 0 MUST-FIX, 1 SHOULD-FIX. The subject held at 65d46fcb... mode 0444 throughout, HEAD matches the dispatch, all nine cited digests reproduce, every live register figure re-measures correctly, the no-cell-edit range excludes D-236 exactly, both Stage A verdicts are ACCEPT 0/0 at mode 0444, and the draft's Stage A observation honesty is exact. Nineteen dispatch attacks and five independent attacks did not land. One independent attack did: the Measured-inputs table and the remeasurement custody clause drop frozen leftover-join v4, v5, v6 and frozen corpus v3, while the draft continues to assert their standing -- a convention both D-238 and D-239 observed in full for the same class of claim. The remedy is confined to the D-240 draft and touches nothing frozen.
